newsitem.title: USA: Imperial to spin off businesses.
newsitem.headline: Imperial to spin off businesses.

text.p: Imperial Bancorp said Friday it will spin off to its shareholders a portion of its specialty lending and finance businesses that focus on the entertainment industry, as well as certain other operations.
The spun-off businesses and assets, to be named SpinCo, will be transferred to a newly formed corporation.

SpinCo will comprise Imperial Bank's Lewis Horwitz Organization, which specializes in entertainment industry lending; the bank's small-business lending group; Imperial Trust Co, a California-licensed trust company; and Imperial Bank's interest in Imperial Credit Industries Inc, a diversified specialty finance company.
Imperial Bancorp is the parent of Imperial Bank.
Imperial said that in connection with the spin-off, it will form a separate broker-dealer, which will also be part of SpinCo's business.

The spin-off is subject to receipt of a letter from the Internal Revenue Service confirming it will not be taxable to Imperial shareholders. The transaction is expected to close in late 1997 or early 1998, the company said.
Imperial officials were not available for further comment.
